# Feature: Keys and locks

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Add coloured keys and matching lock blocks, the core gating mechanic beside orbs. Keys occupy the player's 8 inventory slots; pressing against a matching lock consumes one key and dissolves the lock.

## User Story

**As a** player
**I want** to pick up keys and open matching locks
**So that** I can open paths that were blocked.

## High-Level Use Case

Player walks onto a key and it enters the first free inventory slot. Pressing against a lock of the same colour consumes one matching key and the lock dissolves. A wrong-colour lock does nothing.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given a key tile, when the player walks onto it, then the key enters the first free of 8 slots.
- Given a full inventory (8 keys), when the player walks onto a 9th key, then the key stays on the floor.
- Given a matching lock, when the player presses against it holding that colour, then one key is consumed and the lock dissolves.
- Given a wrong-colour lock, when the player presses against it, then nothing happens.
- Colours are exactly red, gold, green, blue and silver; a key only opens its own colour lock.

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Inventory holds at most 8 keys.
- Lock colour must match key colour exactly.
- Dissolved locks become walkable floor.
- Key/lock art is per-colour source art; hue-rotated placeholders are retired.

## UI / Feedback

- Inventory slots (8) in the HUD; key and lock sprites per colour.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Sprites (real art, NO colour shifting): 5 key/keylock combos in assets/published/lock_and_keys — key_red/keyhold_red, key_gold/keyhold_gold, key_green/keyhold_green, key_blue/keyhold_blue, key_sliver/keyhold_sliver (silver) — derived by tools/prep_level_sprites.sh to key_<colour>.png and wall_keyhole_<colour>.png for red, gold, green, blue, silver.
- Level JSON: keys-room Test Level with all 5 keys, matching locks and an orb.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Key pickup fills the first free slot.
- [ ] 9th key stays when full.
- [ ] Matching lock consumes the key and dissolves.
- [ ] Wrong-colour lock does nothing.
- [ ] Recorded session replays to the same end state.

## Out of Scope

- Non-key inventory items.

## Open Questions

- None.

## Testing

Needs a mechanics playground: new — a keys-room Test Level with keys, locks and an orb. Verification should record play sessions for replay.
